# TransferPlayerUIOptions Interface

Customizes the progress screen shown while transferring a player to another server. Text fields accept strings or RawMessage values. RawMessage translations are resolved in the receiving player's language.

## Properties

### **bodyText**
`bodyText?: minecraftserver.RawMessage | string;`

Custom body text for the transfer progress screen. Accepts a string or a RawMessage. If omitted, the default progress message is used.

Type: [*@minecraft/server.RawMessage*](../../../scriptapi/minecraft/server/RawMessage.md) | *string*

### **bodyVisible**
`bodyVisible?: boolean;`

Boolean to determine if the body text is visible on the server transfer loading screen.

Type: *boolean*

### **cancelButtonDelaySeconds**
`cancelButtonDelaySeconds?: number;`

A delay in seconds before the cancel button is made visible on the server transfer loading screen. This will override the 'cancelButtonVisible' option if set.

Type: *number*

### **cancelButtonText**
`cancelButtonText?: minecraftserver.RawMessage | string;`

Custom label for the transfer progress screen's cancel button. Accepts a string or a RawMessage. If omitted, the default cancel label is used.

Type: [*@minecraft/server.RawMessage*](../../../scriptapi/minecraft/server/RawMessage.md) | *string*

### **cancelButtonVisible**
`cancelButtonVisible?: boolean;`

Boolean to determine if the cance button text is visible on the server transfer loading screen.

Type: *boolean*

### **titleText**
`titleText?: minecraftserver.RawMessage | string;`

Custom title for the transfer progress screen. Accepts a string or a RawMessage. If omitted, the default progress title is used.

Type: [*@minecraft/server.RawMessage*](../../../scriptapi/minecraft/server/RawMessage.md) | *string*

### **titleVisible**
`titleVisible?: boolean;`

Boolean to determine if the title text is visible on the server transfer loading screen.

Type: *boolean*
